name: trustlens-ai
description: TrustLens AI — AI-Powered Dark Pattern & Privacy Trap Detector

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w extension
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w extension
